entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, you're home. I've been waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The chief seems strangely happy. I wonder[n]what's going on.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey [fName], how's your pocket money[n]situation been looking?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hahaha, you're hopeless!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What? Is this... five thousand yen!?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I won some money from the lotto, so I don't[n]mind sharing my winnings.
How much did you win?
Thanks.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't worry about the details.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Or what, is that five thousand yen not[n]enough for you?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: See, I can be nice sometimes.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, make sure you close up the shop[n]like always.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, so... does this mean that fortune teller[n]was right?
I think so.
This is kinda scary...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She even got the amount spot on!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe that Chihaya lady can seriously[n]read into the future!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait... This is bad! Didn't she say you're[n]gonna die!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we need to go talk to her again[n]and figure out what to do!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...And maybe I can have her read my[n]compatibility fortune with—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: U-Um, never mind!
It seems like Chihaya Mifune can[n]actually see into the future...
Maybe I should go back and have her read[n]my fortune again...
And there's the Holy Stone too... She said[n]it costs one hundred thousand yen...
